$comment: The ISEDRAF FIXED PRIVILEGED OPERATION registry (D-123, docs/architecture/FULL_AUDIT_AUTHORITY_MODEL.md section 4). Consumed by scripts/ci/check_privileged_operations.py. Every privileged acquisition maps to exactly one entry here (AUTH-004); no entry takes a caller input (AUTH-003). read_shadow_v1 is IMPLEMENTED (v0.2 P5c): reachable through the Full Audit route and requested by the accounts section (AUTH-024). lib/isedraf/supervisor/contracts.py mirrors the entries it has a performer for, field for field (check_privileged_operations.py), and the supervisor refuses every entry that is not IMPLEMENTED. No second operation before the first slice is validated on the lab corpus (AUTH-025).

operations.purpose: Read one mountinfo table for each distinct mount namespace on the host.
targets: /proc/<pid>/ns/mnt for every pid, deduplicated by namespace
operations.privilege_basis: reading other processes' mount namespace links (/proc/<pid>/ns/mnt), to tell the namespaces apart, needs ptrace read access to them: measured EACCES without it (IQ-055). Reading the host mount table through /proc/1/mountinfo needs no privilege on the measured platforms and is not this operation

operations.purpose: Read the authorized_keys files of local accounts.
targets: per-account key files; derivation not yet specified
operations.privilege_basis: other users' home directories are not traversable by the engine identity

operations.purpose: Read the local shadow password database.
operations.privilege_basis: the file is readable by root (and on some distributions group shadow) only

operations.purpose: Read /etc/ssh/sshd_config, the listing of /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d and its directly enumerated entries, without parsing or following a symlink; declared configuration only, never sshd (AUTH-030).
targets: each non-symlink regular directory entry directly enumerated in /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d
operations.privilege_basis: on the measured platforms (Debian 12, Ubuntu 24.04, Rocky 9, AlmaLinux 9) /etc/ssh/sshd_config is 0644 and /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d 0755, readable and listable by the reduced engine; privileged acquisition is required for root-only drop-ins such as the measured 0600 entries; uid 0 is sufficient, no capability is added (IQ-060)

operations.purpose: Read /etc/sudoers, the listing of /etc/sudoers.d and its directly enumerated entries, without parsing or following a symlink (AUTH-029).
targets: each non-symlink regular directory entry directly enumerated in /etc/sudoers.d
operations.privilege_basis: /etc/sudoers is 0440 root:root and /etc/sudoers.d 0750 root:root: the reduced engine is refused on the file, the listing and every entry (measured, IQ-056); uid 0 alone reads them, so no capability is added

operations.purpose: Run the fixed /usr/sbin/sshd -T once and return its stdout unparsed: the global effective OpenSSH server configuration only, without connection context; Match-dependent values are not resolved (AUTH-031).
targets: the stdout of the fixed executable below: the global effective configuration, no -C connection context
operations.privilege_basis: on the measured platforms (Debian 12, Ubuntu 24.04, Rocky 9, AlmaLinux 9) sshd -T as the reduced engine is refused on root-only drop-ins such as the measured 0600 entries and, without them, on the host keys; uid 0 is sufficient and no capability is added - the output was identical with an empty bounding set (IQ-061)
